issue.title: §[simd] math functions should not needlessly access `errno`

discussion.p:
Throughout subclause , it is stated that access to `errno` is unspecified. This allows otherwise non-compliant optimizations like `-fno-math-errno`.
Unfortunately, the wording inadvertently permits accessing `errno` for no good reason, even when the underlying math function would have never done so. For example, `std::sqrt(0)` does not access `errno`, but it is unspecified whether std::simd::sqrt(std::simd::vec<double>(0)) accesses `errno`.
